mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in INDPRO, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by > 3pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate by more than 1% in a month signals an aggressive monetary tightening that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises > 1% in a month but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the housing starts series HOUST is rising and the unemployment rate UNRATE is falling, it signals a strong demand environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rising and UNRATE falling, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate UNRATE is above 6% and rising, it signals a weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6% and rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate FEDFUNDS is above 5% and the consumer price index CPIAUCSL is rising, it signals a high-inflation environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% and CPIAUCSL rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales RSAFS by more than 5% month-over-month signals a sudden demand shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS drops > 5% m-o-m but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.
